name: Trowel
description: Installs Trowel, a webhook and NATS JetStream relay, and runs it as an s6-overlay service.

version.description: Trowel release to install, such as `0.1.0`. `latest` installs the newest stable release.

listen.description: Address the starter configuration serves webhooks, `/healthz`, and `/readyz` on.

natsUrl.description: NATS server URL written to the starter configuration.

serviceUser.description: User account that runs Trowel. Automatic selection prefers the remote user, container user, `vscode`, then `root`.
